$comment: Typecheck only — this repo emits nothing. `erasableSyntaxOnly` is the load-bearing option: coverage/cov-v1.ts is published as the reference implementation and is run by Node's own type stripping (no build step, no bundler, zero dependencies), so it may only contain syntax Node can erase. A TS enum or a parameter property would typecheck fine and then fail at runtime for every consumer.
